title: Availability of per-cell HCR tables and sample metadata for Figure 3
body:
Hello,

I am checking whether the paired molecular and projection measurements in Rossi et al. (2021) can support an evaluation across independent animals for a computational reconstruction project.

The Figure 3 HCR notebook references the AG09_C1/C2, AG10_A2 and AG11_C1/C2 HALO quantification exports, as well as HCR_data.csv. I could not find those tables in the repository or the GEO deposit. Is there a public location for the per-cell tables, including the mouse/section identifiers, gene and reporter counts, coordinate metadata, and final QC/reporter thresholds? A public data pointer would be ideal.

GSE169176 describes three pools, each containing two animals. Could you also clarify whether the pools contain disjoint animals and whether a pool-to-animal mapping is available? If additional independent HCR animals or tracer-counterbalanced samples are available, a pointer would help assess whether a sufficiently powered validation is feasible.

Please also indicate the applicable data reuse terms. We would retain double-labelled and unlabelled cells as separate statuses rather than treating lack of reporter detection as proof of no projection.

Thank you.
